key.name: dock-mode
key.description: 0 = one dock follows the mouse, 2 = primary monitor only. Value 1 is reserved and currently falls back to mode 0.

key.name: dock-location
key.description: 0 = bottom, 1 = left, 2 = right, 3 = top.

key.name: preferred-monitor
key.description: Current monitor for the single follow-mouse dock.

key.name: monitor-count
key.description: Last known monitor count for preferences UI options.

key.name: follow-mouse-poll-ms
key.description: Mouse position polling interval in milliseconds.

key.name: follow-mouse-debounce-ms
key.description: Required edge dwell time before switching monitors, in milliseconds.

key.name: follow-mouse-edge-px
key.description: Trigger edge area size in pixels.

key.name: follow-mouse-fast-speed
key.summary: Follow mouse fast edge push speed
key.description: Pointer speed threshold in pixels per second for immediate monitor switching when hitting the dock edge.

key.name: follow-mouse-icon-size
key.description: Native Dock icon size in pixels.

key.name: show-apps-icon
key.description: Reserved for future GNOME Shell applications grid integration.

key.name: active-dot-color
key.description: Color used for the active application highlight dot.

key.name: follow-mouse-debug
key.description: Enable verbose logs for Native Dock Follow Mouse.

key.name: intellihide-enabled
key.description: Auto-hide the dock when a maximized window overlaps it. Hover near the dock edge to reveal.

key.name: intellihide-hover-delay-ms
key.description: Delay in milliseconds before the dock appears when hovering near the edge.

key.name: intellihide-hide-delay-ms
key.description: Delay in milliseconds before the dock hides after the mouse leaves.

key.name: dock-edge-margin
key.description: Distance between the screen edge and the dock when dock is at top or bottom, in pixels. Negative values push the dock closer to the edge.

key.name: dock-edge-margin-vertical
key.description: Distance between the screen edge and the dock when dock is at left or right, in pixels. Negative values push the dock closer to the edge.

key.name: dock-icon-spacing
key.description: Gap between app icon containers in pixels. 0 = no extra gap.

key.name: edge-reveal-timeout-ms
key.description: Duration in milliseconds that the dock stays visible when revealed by cursor at screen edge during fullscreen, or when revealing from intellihide.

key.name: background-preset
key.description: 0 = Native dark, 1 = Light translucent, 2 = Transparent (no background), 3 = Custom color.

key.name: background-custom-color
key.description: Hex color code used when background preset is Custom. e.g. #38383b

key.name: background-custom-opacity
key.description: Opacity level (0.0–1.0) used when background preset is Custom.

key.name: background-padding
key.description: Vertical padding in pixels between the dock background edge and app icons. Applied to both top and bottom. Total added height = 2x this value.

key.name: background-border-radius
key.description: Border radius in pixels for the dock background.
